[[File:Perez_-_Tri-lichanon_goni-arith-metron,_1781_-_4638622.tif|thumb|Illustration from the ''Tri-lichanon goni-arith-metron'']]

'''Francesco Perez''' was an 18th-century Italian [[abbot]] and mathematician, whose work ''Tri-lichanon goni-arith-metron'', describing a [[goniometer]] (instrument for measurement of angles), was published in 1781.<ref>{{Cite book|title=Gazzetta universale, o sieno notizie istoriche, politiche, di scienze, arti, agricoltura ec.|volume=8|year=1781|page=256|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=9HMpAAAAYAAJ&pg=PA256|language=it}}</ref> He later published a letter complaining about the "plagiarizing usurpation" of this invention by [[Eliseo della Concezione]].<ref>{{cite book|title=Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani|chapter=ELISEO della Concezione|url=https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/eliseo-della-concezione_(Dizionario-Biografico)/|publisher=[[Treccani]]|year=1993|volume=42|language=it}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London|location=London|year=1786|volume=76|page=514|url=https://archive.org/details/philosophicaltr04unkngoog/page/n560}}</ref>
